{
  "title": "Unit 6 – Vocabulary",
  "subject": "English",
  "className": "P5 B",
  "unitTitle": "VOCABURARY",
  "language": "English",
  "slides": [
    {
      "layout": "title",
      "heading": "Unit 6 – Vocabulary",
      "bullets": ["Vibrant English words","45 minutes"],
      "notes": "Welcome the class and introduce today’s vibrant vocabulary theme."
    },
    {
      "layout": "bullets",
      "eyebrow": "Objectives",
      "heading": "Learning goals",
      "bullets": ["Identify 20 new words","Use words in sentences","Pronounce correctly"],
      "notes": "Explain that by the end they will know, say and write the new words."
    },
    {
      "layout": "twoColumn",
      "eyebrow": "Word List",
      "heading": "Everyday vocabulary",
      "bullets": ["Market – market","Rwanda – country","Kigali – capital","Rwf – currency","Bus – transport","School – place","Teacher – educator","Friend – companion"],
      "notes": "Read each pair aloud, point to pictures on the board and ask for Rwandan equivalents."
    },
    {
      "layout": "callout",
      "eyebrow": "Key rule",
      "heading": "Pronunciation tip",
      "bullets": ["Stress the first syllable in most English nouns","e.g., market"],
      "notes": "Model the stress on ‘MARK‑et’ and have students repeat."
    },
    {
      "layout": "steps",
      "eyebrow": "Procedure",
      "heading": "Sentence building steps",
      "bullets": ["Choose a word","Add a verb","Add a subject","Check meaning"],
      "notes": "Guide pupils through each step with a sample sentence on the board."
    },
    {
      "layout": "image",
      "eyebrow": "Visual",
      "heading": "Rwanda market scene",
      "bullets": ["Shows stalls","Shows prices in RWF"],
      "imageIdea": "Photo of a bustling Kigali market with price tags in RWF",
      "notes": "Point out the items and prices, linking them to the new vocabulary."
    },
    {
      "layout": "question",
      "eyebrow": "Check",
      "heading": "Quick quiz",
      "bullets": ["What is the English word for 'umuhanda'?"],
      "notes": "Answer: road. Confirm understanding and move on."
    },
    {
      "layout": "compare",
      "eyebrow": "Contrast",
      "heading": "Singular vs Plural",
      "columnLabels": ["Singular","Plural"],
      "bullets": ["bus","child","buses","children"],
      "notes": "Show how the plural forms change and have students repeat both columns."
    },
    {
      "layout": "bullets",
      "eyebrow": "Activity",
      "heading": "Group practice",
      "bullets": ["Create a dialogue using 5 new words","Role‑play market buying","Present to class"],
      "notes": "Students work in pairs, then each group shares their short dialogue."
    },
    {
      "layout": "summary",
      "eyebrow": "Recap",
      "heading": "What we learned",
      "bullets": ["20 new words","Pronunciation rule","Sentence steps","Market vocabulary"],
      "homework": "Write 5 sentences using the new words and bring them tomorrow.",
      "notes": "Summarise key points, remind of homework and thank the class."
    }
  ]
}

slides.heading: Unit 6 – Vocabulary
slides.notes: Welcome the class and introduce today’s vibrant vocabulary theme.

slides.heading: Learning goals
slides.notes: Explain that by the end they will know, say and write the new words.

slides.heading: Everyday vocabulary
slides.notes: Read each pair aloud, point to pictures on the board and ask for Rwandan equivalents.

slides.heading: Pronunciation tip
bullets: Stress the first syllable in most English nouns

slides.notes: Guide pupils through each step with a sample sentence on the board.

slides.heading: Rwanda market scene
slides.imageIdea: Photo of a bustling Kigali market with price tags in RWF
slides.notes: Point out the items and prices, linking them to the new vocabulary.

slides.heading: Quick quiz
bullets: What is the English word for 'umuhanda'?
slides.notes: Answer: road. Confirm understanding and move on.

slides.heading: Singular vs Plural
slides.notes: Show how the plural forms change and have students repeat both columns.

slides.heading: Group practice
bullets: Create a dialogue using 5 new words
slides.notes: Students work in pairs, then each group shares their short dialogue.

slides.heading: What we learned
slides.homework: Write 5 sentences using the new words and bring them tomorrow.
